text:
maria_cs: Heads-up team — EngageFlow cohort seat assigned to AcroHealth for preview. Need 2 things: 1) a 30-min enablement call next week, 2) a short in-product feedback survey and CS touchpoint plan. Anyone owning the survey design?

devin_pm: I'll own the survey. Thinking 6 q's + 1 free text. Will draft today and share link. :memo:

alex_eng: ETA for integration guide? Can prep a quick SDK snippet and sample config.

maria_cs: Perfect. Alex, can you include an event we can hook to for "first-successful-inference" so we can auto-trigger survey email after N days?

alex_eng: yep. sample payload:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/events -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"type":"first-successful-inference","user_id":"{{user.id}}","model":"gpt-3o-redwood"}'
```
I'll add to repo and link in the enablement doc.

onboard-bot: Reminder: seat_assignment created 2026-03-18 14:04 UTC — schedule enablement via /book with available slots.

emma_cs: I'll schedule the enablement. Proposed times: Tue 10:00–10:30 PT, Wed 15:00–15:30 PT. If no preference from customer by EOD, I'll pick Tue. Also note renewal risk: they flagged data residency requirements — capture in intake doc.

devin_pm: Survey draft pushed: https://docs.internal/surveys/engageflow-preview — short link for CS email: https://rwd.in/s/ef-preview-survey

maria_cs: Nice. Action items: @alex_eng add event hook + repo PR by EOD, @devin_pm finalize survey and email copy, @emma_cs schedule enablement and log residency reqs. I'll follow up with the customer and confirm time. :thumbsup:

emma_cs: Logged tasks in Gainsight and tagged priority=high. Will follow up on residency checklist pre-call.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Quick note — let's keep the survey <=4 minutes to avoid drop-off. We'll run a small pilot with the first 5 users and iterate.
